$comment: Hestia's auth contract: the factory-name rule, the OIDC token Keycloak's realm hestia issues and the record
verifies, the scopes per route, GET /v1/auth/verify (the gateway's forward_auth) and which paths the gateway
leaves open. Map rows H5, H6, H7 (~/agent-slack/docs/contracts/factory-contract-map.md). Ruled by Pablo
2026-10-25 (decisions.md, 'every contract between two repos has one shared sample both sides test').
Every reader below reads this file by path and fails, never skips, when it is absent (README rule 3).
A change edits this file first; then every reader and writer listed follows in the same change.

writers.test: record internal/enroll/auth_contract_test.go TestRealmMatchesTheContract (default scopes, the scopes' token flags, the factory scope's mappers, the factory attribute's pattern, the token's life)

readers.side: record token checks and route scopes
readers.test: record internal/auth/auth_contract_test.go TestScopesMatchTheContract; internal/handler/auth_contract_test.go TestRouteScopesMatchTheContract (Server.RouteTable, the table the mux is built from: its patterns and guards equal routes.scoped, routes.developer_only and routes.no_token_at_the_api, plus the routes the test names as not in the contract)

readers.side: record key routes and --role key (the name rule)
record cells registration for an OIDC-only factory

readers.test: verify-stub's own go test (main_test.go TestStubReplaysTheContract), reading this file through RECORD_SPECS_DIR or the same two default paths; gw-test.sh runs it first, with RECORD_SPECS_DIR set

readers.side: the gateway (Caddy) and the real api, end to end
readers.test: record deploy/hestia/test/gw-test.sh: W0 runs the stub's test, W9 replays the verify cases against the api and the stub, W14 the open paths and /health at the gateway and on the api's own port

identity.when: no factory claim; a person's subject: no client_id, no clientId, preferred_username not service-account-*

realm.clients_note: the realm file defines no client; --role enroll makes each one, gw-test its own test clients

client.auth: private_key_jwt (ES256, RFC 7523); gw-test's test client uses a secret

factory_name.rule: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit, at most 63

verify.database: never read: a static key, which only the database resolves, is 401

must_refuse.name: static key
must_refuse.reason: a static factory key is not an OIDC token; verify never reads the key table

must_refuse.name: forged signature
must_refuse.reason: the signature does not verify against the realm's JWKS

token_kinds.oidc_factory: a token the realm signed, with the factory claim (client credentials of factory-<factory>)
token_kinds.oidc_person: a token the realm signed for a person's login: no factory claim, no client_id
token_kinds.oidc_forged: a factory token whose signature was altered
token_kinds.static_key: 43 characters, URL-safe base64 without padding (auth.NewKey's shape), no dot

routes.$comment: Every route the api serves behind a token. scope: an OIDC caller without it is 403 'this token lacks scope <s>'; static keys and Firebase tokens carry no scopes and are not checked. developer_only: a Firebase developer alone; an OIDC caller is 403 whatever its scopes.

cells.name: a factory known only by OIDC registers a cell: 204
cells.factories_row: made by --role enroll --developer (IdentityRepo.EnsureFactory), never by IssueKey

must_refuse.name: no factories row at all
must_refuse.reason: authenticated, never enrolled: the operator's to fix (oidc-factory-row F3)

gateway.$comment: hestia spec reached-as-on-aws FR-6: forward_auth on every path of hestia.thepablo.cl except /ready and /portfolio's static assets. agent-slack record-spec says /health needs no auth; aligning record-spec is Hephaistos's, not this file's.

on_the_tailnet_port.note: the api's own port, bound to the tailnet address (docker-compose.hestia.yml HESTIA_API_PORT); the gateway is not in the path

static_keys.off: every static factory key is 401 without a lookup, at every route of that api
static_keys.at_hestia_today: unset (on): static keys work on the tailnet port; through the gateway they are 401 at verify either way
